headline: Laver Cup Day 3 Finale: Triple-point Sunday at The O2 with trophy on the line
whyCareReason: Every match on Championship Sunday counts for three points. Alcaraz and Zverev battle Fritz and De Minaur in the race to 13 points.

story:
Why this one matters: Championship Sunday arrives at The O2 Arena in London as the 9th Laver Cup reaches its dramatic crescendo on 27 September.

Under Laver Cup rules, point values escalate to three points per match on Sunday. With 12 total points available across four matches, any deficit can vanish in a heartbeat. Yannick Noah's Team Europe and Andre Agassi's Team World enter the final day locked in a fierce pursuit of the 13 points required for the title.

The action opens with a marquee doubles clash pitting Carlos Alcaraz and Alexander Zverev against Taylor Fritz and Alex de Minaur. Singles matches follow, featuring Alcaraz against De Minaur and Zverev taking on Fritz. The black court at The O2 is set for championship drama.
stakes: Sunday points count triple (3 points per win). First team to reach 13 points claims the 2026 Laver Cup trophy.
rivalryAngle: Europe against the rest of the world, in a building that already hosted this event in 2022.
